assets.name: south-gate-bg
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: a wide 16:9 parallax background painting for a Chinese side-scrolling Sun Wukong action game, stage 2 South Heavenly Gate. Use the provided images as architecture/material/painterly style references only. The image must be ONLY distant environment and atmosphere: cloud sea, layered blue-grey storm mountains, massive jade-white celestial fortress walls, vermilion pillars, dark teal tiled roofs and aged gold ornaments. A huge CLOSED double gate slightly right of center, no writing or signage. Stormy late afternoon warm sunlight through blue-grey clouds. Readable broad silhouette layers, reduced contrast in distant areas; game characters and physical platforms will be drawn separately. All lower 35 percent should be softly receding cloud sea, NOT foreground bridge or floor. No foreground solid walkway, no platform edges, no characters, no soldiers, no hero, no giant, no crossbow, no hanging hammer, no siege machine, no moving mechanisms, no text, no symbols that resemble UI, no framing or panel. Wide lateral composition rather than a tunnel, suitable for gentle horizontal parallax. High quality detailed hand-painted 2.5D Chinese mythological game environment matching the references.

assets.name: growth-king
assets.prompt: Edit this existing transparent sprite atlas ONLY to correct atlas packing. Preserve the SAME twelve complete character poses, character identity, exact teal/gold armor design and long sword. Do not introduce new poses or extra characters. Canvas must remain a FOUR column by THREE row grid with equal square cells. Uniformly SHRINK each complete character-and-sword drawing to 65 PERCENT of its current size, then CENTER the complete drawing inside its own cell. Keep at least 35 pixels of completely empty transparent margin on ALL FOUR sides of EVERY cell. No hand, sword, cape, boot, tassel or helmet may cross a cell boundary. Leave wide uninterrupted blank transparent vertical strips between all four columns and horizontal strips between all three rows. All characters face LEFT. Each cell contains one whole connected full-body character including its entire sword, no chopped sword tips. Keep a common foot baseline about 82 percent down each cell. Make painted character interiors fully opaque and background genuinely alpha transparent; no checkerboard, no black fill, no borders, no labels. Preserve the original detailed painted appearance and all twelve action silhouettes. Important: smaller drawings and empty space are essential; DO NOT fill the cells with large figures.

layoutCorrectionHistory.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: a TRANSPARENT RGBA character animation sprite atlas, exactly 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows, exactly TWELVE separate complete full-body poses of the SAME Chinese Heavenly King, Zengzhang / Growth King. Each of the 12 poses occupies its own equal rectangular cell with ample transparent margins, every sword tip, boot and cape entirely inside its cell, no overlap between cells. Aspect ratio 4:3. Actual alpha transparent background, no ground, no scenery, no shadows cast onto floor, no grid lines or labels or text. Character: imposing broad-shouldered mature Chinese male celestial warrior, stern face with a LONG DARK BEARD, ornate teal-blue and antique gold heavy lamellar armor, sculpted gold shoulder guards, teal cloth robe panels, closed armored boots, tall teal-and-gold helmet. Weapon is one continuous large straight Chinese double-edged LONG SWORD with gold hilt and broad pale steel blade, NEVER AN AXE. All poses face screen LEFT in readable strict side/three-quarter-side profile, feet on a consistent low cell baseline, same camera, same body size, same design. High-quality crisp hand-painted 2.5D art, same material rendering as the reference Wukong armor but this is a distinct tall human divine warrior, not a monkey. CELL ORDER row-major: row1 col1 poised idle holding sword slanted downward left; row1 col2 second idle shifted weight sword guarding chest; row1 col3 low horizontal sweep windup sword pulled behind shoulder; row1 col4 powerful sweep contact sword fully extended LEFT at hip height. Row2 col1 sweep follow-through sword extended downward left with torso turned; row2 col2 two-handed overhead cleave windup blade up high; row2 col3 downward cleave mid-stroke blade diagonal toward left floor; row2 col4 cleave recovery with sword point embedded at floor left, body leaned to pull sword out. Row3 col1 wind blade preparation sword horizontal forward; row3 col2 wind blade release broad outward sword slash toward left; row3 col3 recoil / hurt with body leaning backward but feet visible; row3 col4 defeated kneeling on ONE knee with sword lowered to left and head bowed, all body still visible. Prioritize visibly different action silhouettes, complete connected anatomy, identical face and gear. No spare arms, no extra weapons, no giant axe, no dismemberment, no modern weapon.
